_about: BRAWLER 70 ('70 Camaro): its speedometer and rev counter are photographs of the real dials, each its own material and picture (SpeedMeter: 500 x 458 px, 0 to 150 mph, the numbers not quite evenly spaced: marks, in km/h; RpmMeter: 470 x 475 px, RPM/100 0 to 70, the orange from 5,000), their orange needles photographed at rest: each gets a live needle along its own scale, the photographed needle taken out of a copy of the picture (the face from further round). The dials glow at night. Pixels of each picture; needle angles in degrees, 0 = right, 90 = down.
